describes: packages/plugin/outline: the on-demand outline mirror, session state, activation with and without the optional plugins, and writes through doc.apply.

cases.name: empty-until-loaded
cases.covers: controller.ts:94-112 on-demand mirror; model.ts:45-69,203-208 the first read seeds the open items; reads empty until it lands, onResynced on load, a second ensureLoaded resolves at once

cases.name: an-empty-outline
cases.covers: model.ts:45-54 a document with no outline lists nothing and is ready

cases.name: an-incomplete-tree
cases.covers: contract.ts:86 isIncomplete; model.ts:45-69 an item whose parent the read lost is not listed

cases.name: ensure-loaded-refresh-and-failure
cases.covers: controller.ts:356-358 ensureLoaded/refresh; a failed read rejects and reads again next time; refresh keeps what the user expanded, drops what the outline lost (model.ts:236-242), fires onResynced and no onChanged; a refresh during a read joins it and reads once more

cases.name: a-forbidden-read
cases.covers: mirror status forbidden for a permission-denied read; the outline stays empty

cases.name: confirmed-events-fold-whoever-made-them
cases.covers: sync/tree.ts:107-175 foldOutline for created, updated, moved, deleted and restored; controller.ts:61-77,109-110 onChanged with the event origin; an event before the first read changes nothing; a page delete reads the outline again

cases.name: expanded-and-selected
cases.covers: controller.ts:173-186,360-373 isExpanded, expand, collapse, toggle, expandAll, collapseAll, reveal, select; model.ts:210-233 unknown refs and leaves change nothing, a selection keeps its order and drops repeats; getSelected drops refs the outline lost

cases.name: activation-with-no-optional-plugin
cases.covers: controller.ts:190-225: an /A without the actions plugin falls to the target; without link and stage a page is handed back, a website and a named verb are handed on, a page the document lacks is reported, no target is none; not-found throws; no reading position

cases.name: activation-with-the-stage
cases.covers: controller.ts:212-216 a page target moves the stage; controller.ts:148-169 the current item is the last one at or above the top of the view; getCurrentViewTarget is where the view is

cases.name: activation-through-link-and-actions
cases.covers: controller.ts:196-209 an /A runs through the actions plugin as a user dispatch from the outline item; every other target goes through link.activate

nodes.detail: the destination page is not in this document

diagnostics.message: goto: the destination page is not in this document

cases.name: activation-through-link
cases.covers: controller.ts:205-209 with link and no actions plugin every target goes through link.activate: a page reveals through the stage, a website and a named verb are handed on, a page the document lacks is reported; an /A with no target is none

cases.name: create-shows-at-once-and-confirms
cases.covers: controller.ts:293-316 create: an object number from the pool, the item shown before the answer (sync/tree.ts:185-202), the confirmed event and onChanged before the promise settles; select reveals and selects; positions before, after, start and end; not-found for a parent the outline lacks

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: outline.create: the outline has no item 99

cases.name: create-takes-defaults-from-the-optional-plugins
cases.covers: controller.ts:278-305: without them a new item is "Untitled" with no target; with the stage it goes where the view is, with i18n its title is the viewer language's, with a selection it is the selected text on one line; an empty pool reserves a number

cases.name: create-without-the-optional-plugins
cases.covers: controller.ts:290,297: "Untitled" and no target with no stage and no i18n

cases.name: update-move-and-delete
cases.covers: controller.ts:318-347 and sync/tree.ts:203-263: update shows the patch (a lowercase colour, open only with children); move takes items with their children together; delete names each topmost item once, one change; each confirmed before its promise settles; an empty move or delete does nothing

cases.name: undo-shows-the-outline-as-it-was
cases.covers: sync/tree.ts:299-356 undoOf: undoing a delete restores the item and its children in place, undoing a move puts each item back, undoing a create deletes it

cases.name: refused-writes
cases.covers: controller.ts:229-246: without doc.outline.modify every write rejects permission-denied before anything is staged; canEdit; a ref the outline lacks rejects not-found; an engine refusal rejects and the view drops the change with no onChanged

cases.name: an-engine-refusal
cases.covers: controller.ts:257-267 the change's refusal, mapped to a PluginError; the view drops the prediction; not-found for refs the outline lacks before anything is staged

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: outline.update: the outline has no item 99

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: outline.move: the outline has no item 99

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: outline.delete: the outline has no item 99

cases.name: cancellation
cases.covers: controller.ts:230-235 an aborted signal refuses before anything starts; controller.ts:262 a signal aborted while the answer is on its way rejects operation-cancelled and the change still lands; ensureLoaded races the signal and the read lands anyway

cases.name: close
cases.covers: a read and a write on their way when the document closes reject instance-closed; reopening starts idle
